if: the document is a bill of supply referred to in clause (c) of sub-section (3) of section 31
it is issued under rule 49 of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the bill of supply MUST carry the value of the supply, after taking any discount or abatement into account
note: One mandatory particular of rule 49(g), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: value of supply of goods or services or both taking into account discount or abatement, if any; and
